TC1.Test Description: Checks default reset values of GPIO registers and verifies masked write/read behavior across listed addresses. Compares masked read data against expected defaults and computed expected values; increments failure counters on mismatch and reports pass/fail at end.
TC1.Remarks: SKIPPING VRRW registers. when reading default values the din value is becoming 1 automatically if we don't force any value,but if we force zero to din bit level sel becoming high,so that reding value not matched with expected value
TC1.Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Call chk_rst_val(): Iterate i from 0 to CNT-1 over addr_array[i]. If skip_rst_array[i]==1, skip. If read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, skip. Read data_rd = read_reg(addr_array[i]). Mask data = (data_rd & 0xfffffffe). Compare data with default_value_array[i]; on mismatch print failure and increment def_fail_cnt.
2) Call chk_rd_wr(): For each pattern in chk_val[]={0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0xf5f5f5f5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}, set data_wr=pattern.
3) Write phase: For i=0..CNT-1, if skip_array[i]==1, continue. If write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, continue. Else write_reg(addr_array[i], (data_wr & write_mask_array[i])).
4) Read/verify phase: For i=0..CNT-1, if skip_array[i]==1 continue. If write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 continue. If read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 continue. Else read masked data_rd = (read_reg(addr_array[i]) & read_mask_array[i]). Compute wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff). Compute exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])). If (data_rd != exp_val) then increment wr_fail_cnt and print mismatch.
5) After both checks, if (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0) then finish(1) else finish(0).

TC2.Test Description: Configures each GPIO pin for input with negative-edge interrupt enable. Generates a falling edge per pin, waits for the interrupt, checks DIN and group status, clears raw statuses, and validates proper interrupt handling.
TC2.Remarks: Bounded wait is used to avoid an infinite loop. The wait is armed before generating the edge to avoid race. All pads are driven high initially using 0xA0243ffc. System register interrupt enable and GIC IRQ lines (87/88) are used depending on GPIO0/GPIO1 selection.
TC2.Test Steps / Procedure:
1) If GPIO0 defined, enable GIC IRQ 87; if GPIO1 defined, enable GIC IRQ 88.
2) Enable system register interrupt output for GPIO block via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 with the respective GPIO interrupt enable mask.
3) Drive all pads high by writing 0xFFFFFFFF to 0xA0243ffc to set a known state.
4) For i=0..31: program per-pin control at (MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4) with doe=1 (input), neie=1, iclr=1 using ((1<<20)|(1<<18)|(1<<16)); add a small wait.
5) For each i=0..31: pre-clear group raw by writing (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; enable only bit i in MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1; set int_pend=1.
6) Generate a falling edge: write 0xFFFFFFFF to 0xA0243ffc, wait, then write (~(1<<i)) to 0xA0243ffc.
7) Wait (with timeout) until int_pend==0; on timeout, log error and increment test_err.
8) ISR (Default_IRQHandler): set int_pend=0; drive pads back high (0xFFFFFFFF to 0xA0243ffc); read per-pin register; check DIN==0; verify group status bit set in MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1; clear per-pin raw (iclr=1 with doe=1) and clear group raw in MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; verify group status becomes 0; clear system RAW_STCR1 and GIC pending for the selected GPIO; increment errors on any mismatch.
9) End: finish(test_err).

TC2.Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
- For each pin, the interrupt must be observed before timeout; otherwise an error is recorded.
- After negedge, DIN bit for the serviced pin must be 0; else error.
- Group status must indicate the serviced pin set; clearing per-pin raw and group raw must result in group status 0; else error.
- System RAW_STCR1 for the selected GPIO is cleared after service; else error.
- Overall PASS when test_err == 0 at finish.

TC3.Test Description: Enables rising-edge interrupts on all GPIO pins, configures input mode, and verifies that each generated rising edge triggers a group interrupt which is then properly cleared.
TC3.Remarks: A volatile flag is used to detect ISR completion with a bounded timeout. The wait is armed before generating the edge. Pads are driven low/high via 0xA0243ffc to create a single rising edge per pin.
TC3.Test Steps / Procedure:
1) If GPIO0 defined, enable GIC IRQ 87; if GPIO1 defined, enable GIC IRQ 88.
2) Enable GPIO interrupt output in system registers via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 for the selected GPIO block.
3) For i=0..31, program (MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4) to enable posedge detection (0x00020000).
4) Set input mode for groups by writing 0x000000FF to MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1..4.
5) Enable group interrupt MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 = 0xFFFFFFFF.
6) For each i=0..31: drive pads low (0x00000000 to 0xA0243ffc); arm int_pend=1; drive pads high (0xFFFFFFFF) to create a rising edge; wait with timeout for int_pend to clear; on timeout, log error and increment test_err; then drive low again.
7) ISR (Default_IRQHandler): read group status MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1; mask MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 to 0; if group status nonzero log success else error; clear per-pin raw by writing 0x00010000 to each MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_x register; verify group status becomes 0; clear MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 for selected GPIO and verify cleared; re-enable MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1=0xFFFFFFFF; clear GIC IRQ.
8) End with finish(test_err).

TC3.Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
- For each pin, a rising edge must cause the group interrupt status to become nonzero; else error.
- After clearing per-pin raw statuses, the group interrupt status must be 0; else error.
- The system RAW_STCR1 bit for the selected GPIO must be cleared after service; else error.
- Overall PASS when test_err == 0 at finish.
